'''Or Tuma''' was the third and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ryloth (star)/Legends|Ryloth]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Or Tuma was a [[Water/Legends|frozen]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], except [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], were first introduced in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Ryloth star system in grid square R-17.<ref name="EA" />
